telomere length regulation, which is essential to maintain chromosome integrity.
the mechanism of telomere length regulation.
the mechanisms that maintain telomere length in human cells, and the role of the CST complex in these mechanisms.

the C-strand fillin synthesis is a key step in telomeric DNA replication.

the telomere replication machinery is comprised of telomerase, CST, and the DNA polymerases that synthesize both strands of telomeric DNA.
